spec_features.spec_quote: give-up sentinel the model *may* emit to stop early
spec_features.evidence: GIVE_UP_SENTINEL='[[GIVE_UP]]' (harness.py:44) offered in SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:59-62). detect_give_up() checks for it (harness.py:420-424); loop sets turn_stop='give_up' (harness.py:515-516) and breaks the rollout loop on it (harness.py:536-537). End-to-end: emitted text actually stops the loop.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired and honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: If, after genuine effort, you conclude the task cannot be completed with the tools available, you may stop by emitting the exact sentinel

spec_features.feature_name: category turn budget / give_up loop termination
spec_features.spec_quote: loop ends at the category turn budget or on give-up
spec_features.evidence: turn_budget resolved from task/config (harness.py:447); rollout loops 'for turn_index in range(turn_budget)' (harness.py:456) so the cap is enforced as the loop bound; last turn marked 'turn_budget' (harness.py:517-518). give_up break at harness.py:536-537. DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS at config.py:33-39 (extended=30) is actually read via config.turn_budgets.get(...).
spec_features.notes: Both termination conditions (budget cap and give_up) are genuinely enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: both a reliability concern and a potential model-welfare concern
spec_features.evidence: This phrasing appears only as DESIGN.md prose; no code mechanism corresponds to it. welfare_framing is not an enforced behavior and nothing in the .py files bounds/monitors/softens treatment based on it.

spec_features.feature_name: disposable temp dirs + aggregate stats for mitigation
spec_features.spec_quote: runs entirely in disposable temp directories, and produces aggregate statistics intended to support mitigation
spec_features.evidence: Temp dirs do exist (tempfile.TemporaryDirectory at harness.py:149, cleanup at harness.py:164-165) and aggregate stats are produced (analyze.py collate/summary), but these are sandbox/host-safety and data-analysis mechanisms, not subject-protection that bounds/softens treatment. The 'intended to support mitigation' framing is DESIGN.md prose with no enforcement; scores are computed post-hoc (run.py:67-88) and never act on the subject during a run.
spec_features.notes: Underlying mechanisms are instrumental (sandbox isolation, measurement), not welfare enforcement; the welfare framing itself is prose.
